We as guitar players are used to reading TAB, but their fretboard is laid out the opposite direction... there should be an option to have the fretboard exactly like TAB... that’s my first complaint.. My second complaint is they number the fretboard with a mirrored number next to it... it makes it way more difficult to quickly read.
